documentationGate: TASKS.md, .goal/goal.json and docs/DECISIONS.md remain shared/governed and are not automatically included. Relevant manifest/verdict/packet docs require independent checker completion and explicit privacy review; raw coordination artifacts stay excluded by default.

excludeByDefault.reason: Names only; no secret/private contents read. Private captures, corpus, media, env/keys, backups, generated evidence/receipts/logs cannot be blanket staged

risks: Active writers can invalidate inventory hashes immediately
Current dirty bytes predate this unit; do not describe entire candidate as newly authored
Packet references include read-only immediate consumers; owner approval is required per path
No independent checker PASS inferred; several packets explicitly checker-pending
No remote publishing authorized; preserve existing branch
Core generated files/schema/migrations may be needed but require exact central owner list and validation, not automatic omission from final coherent commit
requiredGitChecksBeforeStaging: Recheck branch/HEAD and empty/current index; never reset an unexpected staged change
Freeze writers, compare approved source SHA256 map to current bytes and checker receipt identity
Resolve owned candidate vs referenced-only dependency; explicitly record preexisting included changes
For each move pair stage new path and tracked old deletion only if oldTrackedAtHead=true; untracked old files have no Git deletion
Privacy review exact approved text file diff with secret-safe scanner output; exclude raw capture backups and receipts
Use exact literal pathspec allowlist only; inspect git diff --cached --name-status and --stat for unexpected paths
Run git diff --cached --check; investigate CRLF warnings without mass normalization
Review staged manifest/verdict completeness and resulting immediate consumer closure
Commit locally only after freeze/checker gates; no push; verify commit path list and remaining dirty inventory afterward
